description.value: Dallas Pizza & Souvlaki is a long-running Greek-Italian restaurant on Vancouver's East Broadway, serving an extensive menu of hand-crafted pizzas alongside fire-grilled souvlaki, pasta, and classic Greek dishes. The East Side location has operated for over 16 years and offers both dine-in and takeout service. It sits on a busy urban corridor that connects several cycling routes across Vancouver's east side.
